title: Posting a Departure Morning Breakfast to a Hotel Folio
content:
Where the breakfast a guest owes for a morning of a stay in the Hotel Rate Plans range falls due to be raised, the agency posts it to the reservation's folio against the lead guest. The result this entry governs is the breakfast charged for that one morning. Once the line is posted, the guest can see the breakfast standing on the folio with the other extras taken at the property.

**How the charge is raised.** The desk unlocks the hidden agent tool `post_closing_breakfast_charge_10224aa5` and then calls it. The amount and the morning are worked out from the published terms and the records and handed in; the tool prices nothing, aggregates nothing and judges nothing.

**Values handed in.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stay_reservation_id` | The internal reference number of the hotel reservation whose folio the breakfast is posted to, read from the reservation record returned by the reservation lookup before this call | An identifier |
| `breakfast_amount_usd` | The breakfast charged for that one morning; it is posted to the folio exactly as handed in and is never blank | A positive USD amount with two decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `stay_date` | The morning of the stay the breakfast is charged for | YYYY-MM-DD in the property's own local calendar, with no time part and never blank |

**What the call returns.** A confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the reference of the breakfast line now standing on the folio, repeats the morning it covers as YYYY-MM-DD, and repeats the amount charged as a USD figure to two decimal places. The appearance of that sentence, with a breakfast line reference in it, is what indicates the breakfast has been charged.
